top_signals.title: Emerging Currencies Rise as Traders Cut Bets on Fed Rate Hikes
top_signals.summary: Emerging-market currencies gained as easing bets on a Federal Reserve interest-rate hike next month undercut the dollar and supported risk appetite.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Vitol Makes Push Into Data-Center Infrastructure With US Deal
top_signals.summary: Vitol said its renewables arm had acquired a data center campus in South Carolina from Meridan Gridworks, one of the first instances of a major commodity trader delving into artificial intelligence infrastructure.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: US Bond Selloff Drives 30-Year Yields to The Highest Since 2007
top_signals.summary: The yield on 30-year US Treasuries hit the highest in almost two decades, reflecting investor angst over the surging national debt, a flood of long-dated bond sales and inflation that’s been stuck over the Federal Reserve’s target for the past five years.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.
